configurations.documented_expectation: en-AU is a supported pronunciation assessment locale, but phoneme name, syllable group and spoken phoneme output are documented for en-US only, so the expected result is a per position phoneme accuracy score with no phoneme name.
en-US with the IPA alphabet is documented to return phoneme names, syllable groups and NBestPhonemes spoken phoneme candidates with confidence scores.

field_presence_note: field_presence records whether a key was returned, following the predeclared contract. It does not mean the key was usable. Read it together with keys_present_but_empty and capabilities: a locale can return every documented phone name key and leave all of them blank, in which case the keys are present and the capability is absent

locale_distinctness.interpretation: the two locales returned different utterance accuracy scores on the same audio, so the locale parameter selects a genuinely different model rather than relabelling one result; this is why en-AU and en-US outputs may never be pooled

no_selection_notice: this is response shape and repeatability evidence only; it measures no accuracy, reads no expert label, selects no system and sets no threshold
repeat_comparison_note: the per request identifier is excluded because it is generated fresh for every call; every score and phone name is compared exactly with no tolerance
